title: The importance of family
summary: Bunn says he had few family problems except with his son, and his parents never saw his children.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: One of the things that we keep coming back to, you know, in the interview, talking and so forth, is how important family is to you. You know, like I think a lot of musicians that get into problems, maybe they have a problem with their family. They don't have it tight.
Well, I ain't had none. Thank God. Other than my boy. He's been a little trouble, you know. Naturally, kids --
It's not really anything that serious. But your parents must have been real close.
When you were growing up. Usually people that grow up in a family that's happy, you know --
They were. Only thing, they didn't get to see my children.
Yeah, it's a shame. My dad never got to see my kid, either.
But see, I took care of them. Still taking care of them.
I say I'm still taking care of them.
